doc: The deck's three coverages on a uniform 64x64 rank field, called as coverage_masks(rank) so the DEFAULT coverages (0.3, 0.5, 0.7) are the ones used (params.coverages lists them): masks rank >= round(256 (1 - c)) = 179, 128 and 77, so about 30, 50 and 70 percent of the texels. Output (3, 64, 64) bool, exact.
